source: Wikidata cast lists for Korean titles that reached a Netflix country chart, joined to public profile birth and start dates
question: How many charting titles does one Korean actor have, and does starting young buy more?
unit: Actors. One row is one person, counted once.
whyReachIsNotThePersons: Half of these actors have exactly one charting title, so the reach we could attribute to them is the reach of that one title. It is a fact about the title, not about the person, and no amount of arithmetic separates the two here.
cannotAnswer: It counts titles that reached a Netflix country chart. Theatre, cinema releases that never charted, and broadcast work are absent, so a one-title actor here is not a one-title actor.
